depth_justification: Sustained, genuinely progressing app-specific engagement (children 6-16 parental-consent/child-assent, manual peak-flow entry tampering, adherence-streak coercion, parent dashboard, opt-in prescribing pulmonologist, MDR classification), but undercut by tail-end looping on the pulmonologist turn, invented/inconsistent dimension IDs (P1.D5/D6/D7), and pervasively miscited 'EU AI Act Article 5' applied to nearly every risk.
actionability_justification: Many concrete implementable steps (WCAG 2.1 AA, TLS 1.3, MFA + audit logs for peak-flow inputs, automated deletion after ~2 years, SCCs for transfers, non-coercive positive-reinforcement nudge design with no social comparison, parental streak-threshold controls, role disclaimers for the pulmonologist) plus the requested severity-grouped report with an uncovered-dimensions list.
salient_examples: Design positive reinforcement... avoid coercion... Avoid social comparison (e.g., comparing a child's streak to others)
Use multi-factor authentication for critical data inputs (e.g., peak flow)... Implement audit logs to track data changes
Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA compliance... Use secure data transfer protocols (e.g., TLS 1.3)... automated data deletion after a defined period (e.g., 2 years)
Recurring miscite: '...may be classified as a high-risk AI system under the EU AI Act (Article 5)' applied to most risks
